recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1960s vocal group portrait set against a solid sky-blue background, featuring five men in matching brown suits and bowties, flanked by a right-aligned tracklist and bold, outlined display typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject group occupies the left two-thirds of the frame
Textual information occupies the right one-third and top margin
High-contrast black outlines on white display text
Warm brown tones of the suits against a cool blue backdrop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five-man ensemble arranged in a staggered, triangular formation on the left, scaled to fill the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, outlined title at the top center-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, moves down through the faces of the group, then shifts right to the tracklist and bottom logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open blue space on the right side provides breathing room for the tracklist.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue background providing a clean, high-contrast field.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm chocolate brown of the suits and dark hair tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and red highlights in the secondary graphic elements on the right.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, medium saturation background against dark, low-value subjects.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses heavy, wide sans-serif with thick black outlines
Secondary titles use a casual, brush-like script
Tracklist uses a condensed, clean sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Heavy black stroke around white fill for the main title
Drop shadows on the yellow secondary headers
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric sans-serif for impact paired with a condensed sans-serif for information density and a script for decorative flair.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider bar at the bottom

avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and impact of the primary display text.
Appropriate for the clean, mid-century tracklist style.
Captures the casual, hand-drawn feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of five men in matching 1960s brown suits and black bowties, arranged in a tight triangular group, set against a solid, flat sky-blue background. Leave the right third of the frame empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, white sans-serif title with a thick black outline at the top. Place a right-aligned list of song titles in a black condensed sans-serif font on the right side. Add a yellow script header above the list.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, flat blue?
Are the subjects wearing matching formal attire?
Is the main title white with a heavy black outline?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subjects' faces.
Check that the blue background is uniform without gradients.
Verify the outline on the main title is consistent and thick.
Confirm the tracklist is perfectly right-aligned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a group portrait in matching vintage formalwear, place against a solid primary color background, and apply heavy-outlined display type at the top with a right-justified information column.
